name: dc-ecommerce
description: Digital Store - e-commerce Full Stack educacional (React/TypeScript + Node.js/Express/TypeScript) desenvolvido na Digital College.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start:backend: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix backend start
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:backend && npm run typecheck:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
